trigger.decision: Original confirmatory MAR08 chain is blocked. Revised MAR08 is released only as an exploratory/diagnostic statistical-reassessment stage.

source_authorities.MAR03_implementation: Reuse the frozen MAR03 implementation snapshot and gene-set model interface; no SNP harmonization, liftOver, or SNP-to-gene remapping is permitted.

frozen_scientific_facts.MAR03_sensitivity_only_signal: PGC M02 COMPACT_W10 q=0.0282975; not replicated in SPARK

scientific_role: Localize and characterize the MAR07 calibration failure without attempting to rescue Tier1 pathway claims.
Quantify observed-versus-null stage-level burden as an exploratory omnibus diagnostic.
Audit driver concentration and determine whether the seven frozen higher-order common-variant conclusions are sensitive to omission of rare-anchor driver genes.
Provide a source-driven manuscript decision for MAR09.

analyses: For n_MDV2, n_MDV3 and n_Tier1: event probability P(n>0), mean, SD, median, IQR, P05, P95, min and max.
Correlations among n_MDV2, n_MDV3 and n_Tier1; correlation of reference_B_MDV4 with n_Tier1.
Stratified diagnostics for reference_B_MDV4 <8000 versus >=8000, without excluding either stratum.
No new simulation and no threshold modification.
Use the same 1000 frozen null replicates.
For each stage, compute +1 corrected empirical upper-tail probability P(null count >= observed count).
Report standardized position of observed count relative to null distribution.
Label all results POST_HOC_OMNIBUS_EXPLORATORY; they cannot validate individual pathways.
Use MAR02 frozen raw26 driver membership only; no pathway reselection.
Report raw26_driver_n, dominant_driver_gene, locus_dominated_flag and representative-pathway driver incidence.
Define descriptive driver weights p_g from frozen representative-pathway incidence within target; compute N_eff=1/sum(p_g^2) and C_max=max(p_g).
N_eff and C_max are descriptive only and do not define new significance thresholds.

D_leave_one_driver_common_side.targets: Seven primary higher-order Expanded units only
D_leave_one_driver_common_side.scenario_definition: For each actual raw26 driver gene appearing in any primary unit, remove that gene from every affected frozen Expanded unit in a global omission scenario; all other memberships remain unchanged.
D_leave_one_driver_common_side.model: Reuse MAR03 primary marginal competitive gene-set model on frozen gene-level results; same +/-10 kb mapping authority; same seven-test BH family within each dataset/scenario.
D_leave_one_driver_common_side.interpretation: Any q<0.05 created by omission is SENSITIVITY_ONLY_NOT_RESCUE and cannot revise MAR03 or MAR07.

E_leave_two_driver_common_side.eligibility: Only units with frozen raw26_driver_n between 3 and 10; current expected units are M04 and M05 under MAR02 labels.
E_leave_two_driver_common_side.scenario_definition: Enumerate all driver pairs within the eligible unit; remove the pair globally from all affected primary units; rerun the same seven-test marginal family.
E_leave_two_driver_common_side.maximum_scope: No random search, no pair selection after results, no combinations outside frozen driver lists.

F_null_pathway_recurrence.rule: Run only if pathway-level per-replicate intermediates for all 1000 MAR07 replicates already exist and can be audited without recomputing the full chain.
F_null_pathway_recurrence.allowed: MDV3 pathway recurrence may be calculated from complete persisted mdv3.tsv sidecars if 1000/1000 are present.
F_null_pathway_recurrence.prohibited: Do not rerun 1000 global-null replicates solely to recover pathway identities. If complete MDV4/Tier1 pathway-level outputs were not persisted, record NOT_RUN_WITH_REASON_PATHWAY_LEVEL_NULL_STATE_NOT_FROZEN.

hard_prohibitions: No redefinition of Tier1, BH/BY choice, alpha, pathway family, or matching thresholds.
No deletion of high-null-frequency pathways to improve calibration.
No post hoc creation of a new “rescued” pathway set.
No new external transcriptomic, single-cell, regulatory or direct rare-variant datasets in the current manuscript revision.
No SNP harmonization or SNP-to-gene remapping for MAR08.
No reinterpretation of MAR07 FAIL as PASS/CAUTION.

technical_gates.preflight: All frozen source files exist and hashes/checksums match; seven primary unit memberships and driver lists exactly match MAR02; MAR07 R=1000 distribution complete.
technical_gates.manual_gate_A: Release only after preanalysis lock, scenario counts and input hashes are reviewed.
technical_gates.postflight: No missing scenarios, no duplicate scenarios, deterministic replay of frozen baseline MAR03 values, no mutation of upstream files.

interpretation_gates.common_side_null_robust: If all PGC and SPARK primary units remain non-significant across every leave-one-driver scenario, language allowed: common-side null classification was robust to omission of individual rare-anchor drivers.
interpretation_gates.influence_sensitive: If any omission materially changes beta/sign or produces q<0.05, report influence sensitivity only; the result cannot rescue the primary family.
interpretation_gates.distributed_support: Use distributed/multi-driver language only for units already supported by frozen MAR02 driver architecture and without single-driver dominance in the descriptive influence audit.
interpretation_gates.MAR07_override: No MAR08 result can restore confirmatory status to the 39 BH-defined Tier1 pathways.

manuscript_release_rule: After MAR08 technical PASS, MAR09 may proceed only under the revised claim hierarchy: Tier1 pathways are exploratory/prioritization outputs; the common-variant result remains “no reproducible enrichment detected”; MAR07 calibration failure must be reported explicitly.
